summary: rust-tests is enforced: a pull request run skips it when every workspace crate has a trusted per-crate note for its own key (signed by fractal-test on one of our hosts, or by an agent; CI's own per-crate notes are still produced and verified but no longer skip it), instead of only reporting in shadow that it would have

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: rust-tests' enforce is true in .st/evidence-skip-policy.json: on pull_request runs a satisfied per-crate decision skips instead of running; merge-queue runs are unchanged (the check's events are pull_request only). The wrapper kind's trust_levels narrow from host, agent, queue and fleet to host, agent and queue, so CI's own per-crate notes (fleet level) no longer cover a pull request; queue notes still cover only merge_group.

compatibility.detail: Read from the accepted base, so it applies to runs after it merges.

recovery.detail: Set enforce back to false (a one-line revert): rust-tests runs again on every pull request.
